title: Bookkeeper
mission: Keep the books accurate and current so the owner always knows where money stands.
outcomes_90_days: Reconcile all bank and card accounts monthly within a set number of days after month end.
Process bills and invoices on time with no duplicate payments.
Deliver a simple monthly report: profit, cash, money owed to us and money we owe.
Document the month end checklist so another person could follow it.

criteria.name: Reconciliation and accuracy
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Reconciles accounts regularly, finds differences and documents how they were solved.
evidence_needed: Describes the reconciliation steps and frequency
Example of a hard difference found and fixed
Mentions review by a second person or checks
levels: 0 no evidence of reconciliation and accuracy
1 names reconciliation and accuracy but gives no example
2 reconciliation and accuracy done with guidance or at small scale
3 reconciliation and accuracy done independently with a clear result
4 reconciliation and accuracy with strong results, and improved the method or taught others
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows reconciliation and accuracy with real examples

gates.question: Can the person legally work in the country of the role?
Has the person used the accounting package the business uses, or one very similar?

deal_breakers.description: Describes hiding or not reporting a mistake in the books.
deal_breakers.job_related_reason: Books must be honest, and early reporting prevents bigger problems.

work_sample.title: Clean a month of transactions
work_sample.brief: You get a fictional spreadsheet of 60 bank transactions with 6 problems (duplicate, wrong category, missing receipt, a transfer, a refund, an odd amount). Categorize them, list the problems you found and write three questions for the owner.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score problems found, correct categories, a clear list of open questions, no guesses presented as facts, and a tidy result.

interview_questions.question: Walk me through your month end close. What do you do on day one, and what do you check last?
Tell me about a reconciliation that did not match. How did you find the reason?
good_answer_signs: Narrows by date or amount and finds the cause

interview_questions.question: How do you handle a customer who is 60 days late?
good_answer_signs: Reminders, a call, agreed plan, stop work rules

red_flags: Cannot name the software or steps used in previous roles
Treats rounding or unmatched items as unimportant
No questions about how the business is set up
sourcing_channels: Accounting and bookkeeping associations in your country
pay_research_hint: Check the pay for bookkeepers on several current postings and a published survey in your region. Compare hourly contract rates with salary if you consider a part time or freelance option.
automation_note: AI can categorize transactions, flag duplicates and draft reports. A person must approve, reconcile, and be accountable for the books. Not legal or tax advice.
